camel_example: aliyun live AddLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName StreamName --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Protocol HLS_CMAF --AppName AppName
description_en: Adds a live stream packaging configuration
description_zh: 调用AddLivePackageConfig添加直播封装配置
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --protocol HLS_CMAF --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLivePackageConfig

parameters.help_en: The live streaming domain name (primary streaming domain)
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The application name. The configuration takes effect only when the AppName matches the AppName in the ingest URL. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set the value to a single asterisk (*) to match all AppNames
parameters.help_zh: AppName 名称与推流地址中的 AppName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. The configuration takes effect only when the StreamName matches the StreamName in the ingest URL. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set the value to a single asterisk (*) to match all StreamNames
parameters.help_zh: StreamName 名称与推流地址中的 StreamName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The live streaming protocol and container format. Valid values:

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
(low latency)

LLHLS_CMAF (low latency)
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.help_zh:
直播协议与封装格式。取值：

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
（低延迟）

LLHLS_CMAF（低延迟）
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of M3U8 segments. Valid values: 3 to 10. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
直播M3U8切片个数。

取值范围：3～10。

默认值：3
parameters.name: segment_num

parameters.help_en:
The segment length. Unit: seconds.

If Protocol is set to HLS_CMAF, valid values are 1 to 10. Default value: 5.

If Protocol is set to LLHLS_*, valid values are 1 to 2. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
切片时长，单位：秒。

如Protocol为HLS_CMAF，取值范围1～10，默认5秒；

如Protocol为LLHLS_*，取值范围1～2，默认1秒
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en:
The part segment length. Unit: milliseconds.

If SegmentDuration is set to 1, valid values are 100 to 500. Default value: 350.

If SegmentDuration is set to 2, valid values are 100 to 1000. Default value: 700.

This parameter is valid only when Protocol is set to LLHLS_*
parameters.help_zh:
Part切片时长，单位：毫秒。

SegmentDuration为1s时，取值范围100～500ms，默认350ms。

SegmentDuration为2s时，取值范围100～1000ms，默认700ms。

仅当Protocol为LLHLS_*时有效
parameters.name: part_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore transcoded streams. Valid values:

true (default): ignores transcoded streams.

false: does not ignore transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略转码流，取值：

true（默认值）：忽略。

false：不忽略
parameters.name: ignore_transcode
